title: Learning from Humans for Proactive Assistance in Human-Robot Collaborative Transport
abstract: arXiv:2609.25351v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We focus on human-robot collaborative transport, a challenging task of broad relevance spanning logistics, manufacturing, and the home, in which a user and a robot work together to relocate a large or heavy object. To act as an effective partner, the robot should reduce the user's effort by contributing to efficient relocation of the object while remaining physically responsive to them. Prior work often addresses these capabilities separately, producing robots that may move the object efficiently but resist user input, or accommodate the user but depend on continuous guidance. Our key insight is that obstacle-constrained collaborative transport requires integrating predictions of human collaborative behavior with compliant robot control. To this end, we introduce PROACT, a framework for human-robot collaborative transport that incorporates anticipation into compliant whole-body control through a learned model of human collaborative beh

translated_title: 从人类学习中实现人机协作搬运的主动辅助
translated_abstract: 我们专注于人机协作搬运，这是一项在物流、制造和家庭等领域具有广泛相关性的挑战性任务，其中用户和机器人共同协作以搬运大型或重物。为了成为有效的合作伙伴，机器人应通过促进物体的高效搬运来减少用户的负担，同时保持对用户输入的物理响应性。先前的工作通常将这些能力分开处理，所得到的机器人要么能够高效移动物体但会抵抗用户的输入，要么能够适应用户但依赖于持续的引导。我们的关键洞察是，在障碍物约束下的协作搬运需要将人类协作行为的预测与柔顺的机器人控制相结合。为此，我们提出了PROACT，一个用于人机协作搬运的框架，它通过学习人类协作行为的模型，将行为预期融入到柔顺的全身控制中。
tldr: 提出PROACT框架，通过学习人类协作行为模型将行为预期融入柔顺全身控制，使机器人既能高效搬运重物又能对用户保持物理响应性。
en_tdlr: PROACT integrates learned predictions of human collaborative behavior into compliant whole-body control, enabling robots to efficiently relocate objects while remaining physically responsive to users during collaborative transport.
